name: [Part 1] stores sparse literals and defaults an unset cell to zero
input: C3=14, D8=31, then read C3, D8, E3, and ZZ1000000
test:
sheet = Spreadsheet()
sheet.set_cell('C3', 14)
sheet.set_cell('D8', 31)
assert sheet.get_cell('C3') == 14
assert sheet.get_cell('D8') == 31
assert sheet.get_cell('E3') == 0
sheet.set_cell('ZZ1000000', 9)
assert sheet.get_cell('ZZ1000000') == 9
sheet.set_cell('C3', -4)
assert sheet.get_cell('C3') == -4

name: [Part 2] eagerly propagates formulas, duplicate terms, and replacements
input: B2=12, B3=B2+18, B4=B2+B3+7, then update B2
test:
sheet = EagerSpreadsheet()
sheet.set_cell('B2', '12')
sheet.set_cell('B3', '=B2+18')
sheet.set_cell('B4', '=B2+B3+7')
assert sheet.get_cell('B3') == 30
assert sheet.get_cell('B4') == 49
sheet.set_cell('B2', 3)
assert sheet.get_cell('B3') == 21
assert sheet.get_cell('B4') == 31
sheet.set_cell('D1', '=B2+B2+7')
assert sheet.get_cell('D1') == 13
sheet.set_cell('E1', '=B2+1')
assert sheet.get_cell('E1') == 4
sheet.set_cell('E1', 7)
sheet.set_cell('B2', 10)
assert sheet.get_cell('E1') == 7
assert sheet.get_cell('B3') == 28
assert sheet.get_cell('B4') == 45

name: [Part 3] reevaluates lazily after writes and treats missing references as zero
input: formula chain with an unset dependency followed by an update
test:
sheet = LazySpreadsheet()
sheet.set_cell('B2', '12')
sheet.set_cell('B3', '=B2+18')
sheet.set_cell('B4', '=B2+B3+7')
assert sheet.get_cell('B4') == 49
sheet.set_cell('B2', 3)
assert sheet.get_cell('B3') == 21
assert sheet.get_cell('B4') == 31
sheet.set_cell('H1', '=M9+M9+2')
assert sheet.get_cell('H1') == 2
sheet.set_cell('M9', 5)
assert sheet.get_cell('H1') == 12

name: [Part 4] rejects direct and indirect cycles without mutating the prior state
input: C1=D1+2, then an attempted D1=C1+2; a separate indirect cycle
test:
sheet = ValidatedSpreadsheet()
assert sheet.set_cell('C1', '=D1+2') is True
assert sheet.set_cell('D1', '=C1+2') is False
assert sheet.get_cell('D1') == 0
assert sheet.get_cell('C1') == 2
chain = ValidatedSpreadsheet()
assert chain.set_cell('C1', 2) is True
assert chain.set_cell('D1', '=C1+2') is True
assert chain.set_cell('E1', '=D1+2') is True
assert chain.set_cell('C1', '=E1+2') is False
assert chain.get_cell('C1') == 2
assert chain.get_cell('D1') == 4
assert chain.get_cell('E1') == 6

name: [Part 4] validates labels and formula grammar while retaining accepted values
input: invalid labels, malformed expressions, and a legal numeric string
test:
sheet = ValidatedSpreadsheet()
assert sheet.set_cell('C1', '12') is True
assert sheet.get_cell('C1') == 12
for cell, value in (
    ('c1', 14),
    ('C0', 14),
    ('C1', 'D1+6'),
    ('C1', '=D1+'),
    ('C1', '=D_1+6'),
):
    assert sheet.set_cell(cell, value) is False
assert sheet.get_cell('C1') == 12
try:
    sheet.get_cell('c1')
    raise AssertionError('expected ValueError for an invalid label')
except ValueError:
    pass
